## Security checklist

- [ ] No production APK, private key, keystore, password, token, plaintext DEX, or customer path is included.
- [ ] Product code does not sign APKs or accept signing secrets.
- [ ] Positive, tamper, compatibility, and failure paths are covered.
- [ ] Security claims remain cost-based and bounded.
- [ ] Independent security review is attached when the task is security-sensitive.
